authorization_source: Explicit user continuation after the preserved invalid diagnostic: one fresh controlled baseline attempt, fixed 30-case source audit, fresh final review, then merge PR31 and audit retrieval v3 plus semantic v2 before declaring optimization readiness.
directory_key: exact clean committed implementation SHA at launch
publication_rule: Preserve staging; exclusively create the SHA-keyed publication directory and copy every runner-generated file byte-for-byte with complete file-set/hash equality. Publish the immutable consumption/outcome records separately under attempt_authorizations/SEMANTIC-V2-FRESH-20260908 with their own hashes, even if preflight fails before any runner output exists. Console logs remain local. Never rewrite the runner manifest or normalize financial content.
single_attempt_rule: Invoke only the registered operation wrapper. After local committed registration validation, it creates the fixed consumption marker exclusively and fsyncs the file and directory before any project import, remote review, service/workload preflight or child launch. Any invocation reaching this durable boundary consumes the permission even if zero cases start. All later invocations fail on the marker across implementation SHAs; it must never be deleted/reset. The unchanged launcher started.json guard is only an additional case-capture guard, not the authorization boundary.
operational_isolation: Redirect console logs to an ignored local file and expose compact progress only; stage raw files outside the tracked workspace display. These measures do not exempt any process, change workload thresholds, or change case timing, scheduling, inputs, retries or runtime behavior.
validity_rule: Require the unchanged launcher completion status complete and official_baseline_eligible true, all 60 unique captures/scorings, unchanged models/index, and no workload, evaluation or cleanup violations. Poor answers are preserved and do not invalidate operational capture.
on_operational_failure: Preserve the attempt as invalid diagnostic and stop for direction. No automatic retry or relaxation of controls.
source_audit_rule: After a valid full capture, audit exactly the 30 baseline_audit_ids already frozen in composition.json. Use frozen raw outputs, analyst-visible evidence and source filings with the existing rubric/validators; no replacement of failed cases. Record ineligible or unassessed cases explicitly. Assistant source inspection is not independent human annotation.
merge_rule: Merge PR31 only after valid full capture, fixed-subset audit, denominator/evidence verification and clean fresh final review. Then perform the requested short retrieval-v3/semantic-v2 audit and declare joint optimization readiness only if no blocker remains.
unchanged_contract: No benchmark membership, gold, scorer, production runtime, model/provider settings, prompts, timeout, retry budget, workload thresholds or disabled-judge policy changes. The invalid diagnostic is not baseline 1 and remains immutable.
